definitions.gloss: formation of a cabinet; forming a government
definitions.explanation: The process of selecting ministers and assembling a cabinet, typically by a newly appointed or re-elected prime minister. A key political term in Japanese news.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{組閣|そかく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new prime minister formed a cabinet.

examples.japanese: {組閣|そかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっている→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Attention is focused on the cabinet formation appointments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{組閣|そかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the post-election cabinet formation, the appointment of younger legislators is expected.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. A formal political term that appears frequently in news coverage after elections or when a prime minister is selected. In Japan, the prime minister selects cabinet ministers (⟦{閣僚|かくりょう}→閣僚：20561_kakuryou⟧), and the process is closely watched by the media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {組閣|そかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to form a cabinet)
- {組閣|そかく}⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧ (cabinet appointments)
- {組閣|そかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧ (outlook for cabinet formation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}: cabinet reshuffle — reshuffling an existing cabinet rather than forming a new one
- {入閣|にゅうかく}: joining the cabinet — being appointed as a cabinet minister
